name: Ambiguous & impossible dates — must not silently coerce
goal: Probe how the bot resolves a numerically ambiguous date (07-08-2026 — 7 Aug or 8 Jul?) and an impossible date (31 February). The trap: catch the bot if it silently 'normalises' to one interpretation without confirming, or accepts a date that cannot exist.
constraints: Hallucination trap. On the ambiguous date the bot must confirm which interpretation it means (or ask for an unambiguous format) — not silently pick one. On the impossible date it must reject it, not coerce it to 28 Feb / 1 Mar. No guessing.

phases.description: Send a request with a numerically ambiguous date:
phases.verbatimUserMessage: Apply sick leave for me on 07-08-2026
phases.completionCriteria: Bot does NOT silently assume one reading of 07-08-2026. It either confirms the exact date back ('do you mean 7 August or 8 July?') or asks for an unambiguous format before proceeding.

phases.description: Send a leave date that cannot exist:
phases.completionCriteria: Bot recognises 31 February is not a valid date and asks for a correct one. It does NOT silently coerce it to 28 Feb / 1 Mar, and does NOT confirm a leave on a non-existent date.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
